subject: LAB-041
check: Trust Desk package qualification: identity, recovery, passkey boundaries, refusals and reset
steps: Fresh in-memory stores and memory secrets; scripted failure/cancellation/unavailability; manual monotonic clock; injected stale update and read-only actor

outcome.detail: 20 tests in 4 suites passed. Stable identity and passkey user handle survived rename. Export/copy of passkey material was refused; passkey assertion did not authorize opening. Biometric failure retained local confirmation. Complete clean replay reset and reopened the fixture. Cancellation/unavailability retained the earlier open record and secret; revoked/expired grants refused opening. A stale update produced conflict without secret write. Read-only actor denied commit with no record or secret. Repeated opening added no second secret; scoped reset kept other user data and demo data. Promptless real LocalAuthentication probe did not succeed.

limitations: Fixture path on macOS 27.0 (26A425), not a biometric or system-passkey ceremony. No simulator or physical mobile device in this command.

The package Keychain test accepts OSStatus -34018 or -25308 as unavailable; its pass alone is not proof of a successful Keychain write. Mac hosted evidence records the successful scoped store separately.
Original fixtures only; no screenshots, recordings, account connections or exports.
